Extended Emergencies

In case of extended emergencies (over 12 hours},
the Director shall divide the CRT into 2 or more
teams who will relieve each other.
Logistical support shall be arranged.

Stand Down of CRT

The Director shall determine when the CRT can
stand down after conclusion of the incident.
All parties shall be notified accordingly.
